entities.summary: Cameroun Republic, a political institution in Cameroon during French and British Mandates (1916–1960) (1916–1961). Grew from French Cameroun Mandate and Trusteeship and UPC Rebellion 1955. Led to the emergence of British Cameroons and the Plebiscite.
